About the job
Our client, a listed European logistics group, has signed the acquisition of a German contract logistics business with EUR 420m revenue and around 2,100 employees at 14 sites. Closing is expected in November 2026. To lead the finance workstream of the integration we are looking for an experienced Interim Finance Integration Lead (f/m/d).

Your responsibilities
- Lead the finance workstream within the integration management office and report to the Group CFO
- Ensure Day 1 readiness of finance (bank accounts, payment runs, signatory rules, intercompany setup)
- Drive the 100 day plan: harmonise chart of accounts, align closing calendar and integrate the target into group reporting under IFRS
- Transition from HGB local reporting to group accounting policies, including IFRS 16 for the warehouse leases
- Support the purchase price allocation and the opening balance sheet together with the auditors
- Set up synergy tracking and controlling of integration costs, integrate treasury into the group cash pool
- Manage the exit from the transitional service agreement (TSA) with the seller

Your profile
- At least ten years of experience in finance, with several M&A integrations or carve-outs in a leading role
- Strong IFRS background, experience with consolidation tools such as OneStream or SAP Group Reporting
- Hands-on, structured and able to work with both corporate and local finance teams
- Fluent in German and English
- Available from November 2026 for approx. nine months, three days per week on site in Hamburg

What we offer
A freelance assignment with high visibility at board level, competitive daily rate.
